title: Repeat Re-Inspection Visits on In-Place Home Resale Files: Training Questions
content:
**Rule.** A coming re-inspection on an In-Place Home Resale file carries a repeat-visit surcharge, added into the visit-fee sum for that visit. The repeat-visit surcharge follows the re-inspections already recorded on the file: two or more already recorded add 60.00, exactly one already recorded adds 35.00, and none recorded adds nothing.

| Re-inspections already recorded on the file | Repeat-visit surcharge |
|---|---|
| none | 0.00 |
| exactly one | 35.00 |
| two or more | 60.00 |

## Questions answered by the rule

**Does the initial inspection count as a re-inspection?** No. Only re-inspections already recorded on the file are counted.

**The first re-inspection of a file?** None is yet recorded: nothing is added.

**The second re-inspection?** One is already recorded: 35.00.

**The fourth re-inspection?** Three are already recorded, which is two or more: 60.00.

(The visit counts in these answers are hypothetical.)
